items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh, no. Done? (Laughs) No! I hope not either. I don't know what the Creator has in store for me. I pray I get home safely to my family, and stuff like that, but whatever! Should I not? I have had this opportunity and this could be the last living thing they will hear of their father. You never know what is going to happen. If you get this out, that will be a memorandum for them to live by.
Great. END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
